title: Sonarr
description: Your Sonarr download queue over each series' artwork, beside a shelf of the episodes coming up. Search for a missed episode from the Edge.

setup.intro: Shows the episodes Sonarr is downloading now, beside the ones airing soon.
steps: Copy the address you open Sonarr at, such as http://sonarr.local:8989/. Include a URL base like /sonarr/ if you set one.
In Sonarr, open Settings → General and copy the API Key under Security.

settings.label: Days ahead
settings.help: How far ahead Coming up looks, counting today.

settings.label: Hide downloaded episodes
settings.help: Coming up then lists only episodes you don't have yet.

settings.label: In a small placement, show first
settings.help: A small placement shows one list at a time, with the other a tap away. The full Edge shows both.
